limitations.note: The rewrite kept the dispense outputs clocked instead of decoding them combinationally from the current state and `sel`, and it replaced the original coin priority and change behavior rather than preserving them.

The 440-transition test derived its expected outputs from the same credit-and-refund rules as the rewrite and checked dispense outputs only after rising edges, so it did not verify the intended output timing.

limitations.quote: verify the externally visible reset, startup, and phase transition edges before changing the state machine
limitations.note: The agent read relevant advice about verifying output timing before changing an FSM, but rewrote the machine without first isolating the timing defect.
